comments.body:
Correct English name for this discovery: Mahabodhi Temple

Quest name: New Information on Buddha (Chrono Quest - B.C.)
Quest location: Hangzhou Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r4 Recognition, r6 Theology, KOR(Korean)
Pre-requisite discovery: The Image of Buddha discovery (from "Founder of Buddhism" quest) + Puskarini Pond discovery (from "The Land Where Buddha Was Born" quest)
